meaning: 更愿意晚些时候看这部电影
usageNote: prefer to 就是'更想做某事'，表达个人小偏好，语气超温和，不是命令哦！

examples.en: I prefer to see the film at a later time since I have a meeting tonight.
examples.zh: 我今晚有会议，更想晚点再去看这部电影。

examples.en: She prefers to see the film at a later time when the cinema is less crowded.
examples.zh: 她更喜欢电影院不那么拥挤的时候再去看这部电影。
